POST /accounts/{account_id}/data-securit.description:
Check a candidate custom finding type without creating it, so problems can
be corrected before publishing. The request body is the same shape as
`CreateFindingType`, and the candidate is checked against the same rules, so
a valid result means the definition itself is sound. It is not a reservation:
a create can still be rejected for a reason that does not belong to the
definition, such as the account already holding the maximum number of custom
finding types.

A candidate that fails validation is still a **200** with
`result.valid: false` and one entry in `result.errors` per problem — that is
the answer this endpoint exists to give. `4xx` is reserved for a request
that could not be processed at all, such as a body that will not parse.

parameters.description: Cloudflare account ID for the user making the request.
parameters.name: account_id

applies_to_all_integrations.description: When true, this finding type applies to every current and future integration of the vendor.

asset_class.description: Asset class this finding type applies to (PascalCase, e.g. GoogleWorkspaceFile)

allOf.description: Vendors whose assets a finding type can evaluate.
Canonical vendor enum for the platform whose assets this finding type evaluates.

description.description: Human-readable description of the finding type. Cannot be empty. Maximum 4096 characters.
description.example: Detects files shared with too many users

expression.description: Rego expression body for the policy. `package cloudflare.casb.custom` and `import rego.v1` are added automatically. Do not include package or import declarations. This field cannot be changed after creation. Maximum 4096 characters.

integration_ids.description: Required and non-empty when applies_to_all_integrations is false; omit when it is true.

name.description: Human-readable name for the finding type. Maximum 256 characters.

allOf.description: The severity level of a finding.
Default severity used when no integration-specific severity override exists.

errors.description:
Every problem found with the candidate, so all of them can be surfaced at
once. Empty when `valid` is true. Problems without a location come
first, followed by located problems ordered by `line`, then `column`.

code.description:
Machine-readable identifier for the class of problem, when one is
available. Omitted otherwise.

column.description:
1-based column on `line`. Omitted when the problem could not be located in
the submitted source.

field.description:
Request field the problem belongs to, matching the property names of
`ValidateFindingTypeRequest`. Array properties are reported per entry with
a zero-based index, for example `integration_ids[0]`. Empty when the
problem cannot be attributed to a single submitted field.

line.description:
1-based line in `expression` where the problem was found. Omitted when
the problem could not be located in the submitted source.
